blocks.text: Virtual event hosts juggle speaker coordination, attendee support, and technical troubleshooting. Slack acts as your command center. When you are on a Mac, you must master the keyboard to stay ahead of the run-of-show. Pressing Command + / opens the full list of shortcuts inside the app. This is the fastest way to learn how to navigate your workspace.
Key navigation shortcuts for event hosts

items: Command + K: The quick switcher for jumping between channels and direct messages.
Command + G: Use this to perform a general search across all your event workspaces.
Command + F: Search only within the currently open channel or conversation.
Command + ,: Open your Slack preferences to adjust notification settings for busy event days.

blocks.text: During a live event, you cannot afford to click through menus. Use these shortcuts to keep your hands on the keyboard. If you forget a specific command, hold Option + Command and ask Lazur to point at the menu item you need. It draws a circle around the button so you can find it instantly.
Using Lazur to speed up your Slack workflow

Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac. It helps you execute tasks without moving your mouse. When you need to find a specific speaker briefing, just hold the shortcut key and ask Lazur to find the file. It does not click buttons for you, but it guides you through the process step by step.

Event days involve hundreds of messages. Use Shift + Enter to create line breaks in your messages. This keeps your updates readable for the production team. If you are overwhelmed, use the [mark as unread](/how-to/mark-a-message-as-unread-in-slack) feature to revisit important questions later. This prevents you from losing track of critical speaker needs.

Slack version 4.53.x requires macOS 14 or higher. If the app feels slow, it is likely a cache issue. Navigate to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This is a common fix for performance drops during long events. If you are still having trouble, ask Lazur to explain the steps to verify your system requirements.

You likely send the same information to speakers and attendees repeatedly. Use Lazur to draft these responses. Hold the function key to dictate your text directly into the Slack input box. Lazur ensures your text is formatted correctly. This saves you from typing the same instructions dozens of times per event.

items: Pin important run-of-show documents to the channel header.
Use threads to keep conversations focused on specific event sessions.
Set your status to away during critical production moments to reduce interruptions.
Use the search modifiers like from: or in: to narrow down your message history.

blocks.text: If you struggle to find messages, remember that Slack search is powerful. Use the search bar to filter by date or sender. If you cannot remember the syntax, ask Lazur to explain how to use search modifiers. It will provide the correct format so you can find your data in seconds.

faq.question: How do I find the right Slack shortcut on my Mac?
faq.answer: Press Command + / inside the Slack app to open the full list of available keyboard shortcuts.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Slack for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps. It guides you by pointing at the screen and answering your questions out loud.

faq.question: What should I do if Slack is crashing on my Mac?
faq.answer: Try clearing the app cache by going to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart in the Slack menu.

faq.question: Does Lazur store my Slack messages?
faq.answer: No. Lazur only sees your screen and listens while you hold the shortcut key. Your data is not stored or used to train AI models.
